One identity, one turn, and the turn costs 3-year training, 438 supervised growings, quality exam, annual re-assessment. Minutes add up the same way: 15 for one, 6060 for 404, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. The prism is the first thing checked, the forge is the first thing charged, and the onyx is the last thing forgotten. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
